hooks.name: Task completion bookkeeping
hooks.description: After a spec task completes, make the agent keep tasks.md and STATUS.md honest.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Before moving on: (1) run `node scripts/quality-gate.mjs` and fix any failure; (2) tick the task's checkbox in .kiro/specs/crdt-kernel/tasks.md only if its acceptance criteria are actually met by passing tests; (3) update STATUS.md (current task, tests passing, open issues) with facts you verified, not estimates; (4) commit with the task ID in the message, one task per commit.
